purpose: Measure the first action and complete-turn agreement of the frozen routed-v6 direct policy with the independently validated native three-turn search teacher on direct-policy self-play states. This is a distillation-target diagnostic, not a policy-strength or Elo test.
arena: Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two players, 2400-action finite horizon
rollout: Frozen routed-v6 direct against the identical frozen routed-v6 direct checkpoint. Use procedural_v1 route generator, deterministic argmax actions, and record terminal versus action-limit adjudicated games separately.
teacher: Native root whole-turn beam256/top8 distinct completed turns, opponent full-turn beam64, root followup beam32. Evaluate the teacher at every direct-policy action without replacing the executed action.
analysis: Report by-seat atomic-action agreement, first-action agreement and exact completed-turn agreement, total turns, terminal and adjudicated games. Group the two rotated seats by independent map for any uncertainty statement; do not call agreement a win-rate or strategic improvement. Inspect whether disagreements concentrate on nonstatic turns and map seeds without tuning a policy on this window.
resources: Heavy computation only on SSH server fedora-toolbox, one pinned CPU at nice19 with Rayon/BLAS thread caps, bounded wall time and tiny JSON output. Check aggregate disk, memory and CPU first, and do not touch other workloads.
